grammarFocus: 第三人称单数；do / does 问答；like；can / cannot；and / but。
title: A Family Meal and Abilities
instructions: 这是为A1水平学习者设计的听力练习。请先听录音（或阅读听力原文），然后回答问题。题目类型包括单选和填空。填空答案必须使用原文中的单词，且不超过字数限制。所有问题均基于听力内容，不要求推断。注意：本材料为模拟教育内容，不是官方雅思考试。
transcript: Mia: Hi, Tom. This is my family photo. This is my mother. She likes noodles. Tom: Does she like rice? Mia: No, she doesn't. She likes noodles and fish. Tom: Can she cook? Mia: Yes, she can. She can cook very well. Tom: What about your father? Mia: He likes chicken. But he cannot cook. Tom: Can he swim? Mia: No, he cannot. But he can run fast. Tom: Does your brother like eggs? Mia: Yes, he does. He likes eggs and milk. Tom: Can your brother play football? Mia: No, he cannot. But he can play basketball. Tom: And you? Mia: I like apples. I can sing, but I cannot dance.

questions.explanation: Mia说“She likes noodles.”，所以母亲喜欢面条。
Tom问“Can she cook?”，Mia回答“Yes, she can.”，所以母亲会做饭。
Mia说“He likes chicken.”，所以父亲喜欢鸡肉。
Mia说“But he cannot cook.”，所以父亲不会做饭。

questions.prompt: Mia的哥哥喜欢鸡蛋和什么？请用原文单词填空。
questions.explanation: Mia说“He likes eggs and milk.”，所以哥哥喜欢鸡蛋和牛奶。
Mia说“But he can play basketball.”，所以哥哥会打篮球。
Mia说“I like apples.”，所以Mia喜欢苹果。
Mia说“I can sing, but I cannot dance.”，所以Mia会唱歌。
questions.evidence: I can sing, but I cannot dance.

grammar.title: 第三人称单数；do/does问答；like；can/cannot；and/but
grammar.explanation: 在一般现在时中，当主语是第三人称单数（如he, she, it）时，动词要加-s或-es。例如：like变为likes，cook变为cooks。疑问句用does引导，动词用原形。例如：Does she like rice? 回答用Yes, she does.或No, she doesn't. can是情态动词，后面接动词原形，否定形式是cannot。and表示并列，but表示转折。
grammar.example: She likes noodles. Does she like rice? No, she doesn't. She can cook. But he cannot cook.

questions.explanation: 主语She是第三人称单数，动词like要加-s，所以选“She likes apples.”。
第三人称单数疑问句用Does，动词用原形like，所以选“Does he like chicken?”。
can的否定形式是cannot，后面接动词原形，所以选“He cannot swim.”。

options: I like apples and I cannot dance.
I like apples but I cannot dance.
I like apples or I cannot dance.
I like apples so I cannot dance.
answers: I like apples but I cannot dance.
questions.explanation: 前后句意转折，用but连接，所以选“I like apples but I cannot dance.”。
questions.evidence: I like apples but I cannot dance.

speaking.part2: Describe a family member's likes and abilities. You should say:
part3: Do you like rice or noodles?

transfer.writing: Write 5 sentences about your family. Use like, can, cannot, and, but. Example: My mother likes fish. She can cook. My father cannot cook. He likes chicken but he cannot cook. I can sing but I cannot dance.
